inicial.meta_descricao: Carbono Consciente: edukesen long saed blong karbon emisen, kabon futprint, gudfala advaes blong sastenabiliti, nambawan infomesen mo nius long saed blong envaironment.

hero.titulo: Evri smol fasin i mekem plenet i karem lesmo hevi
hero.texto: CARBONO CONSCIENTE I NO WAN GRIN MAK NO WAN FAWE GOL — HEM I KAM FROM PLANTI SMOL JUIS WE YU MEKEM EVRIDE: WANEM YU PLANIM, OLSEM WANEM YU MUV RAUN, WANTAEM YU KILIM LAET I DAI, WEA YU TROMWEI RABIS.

acordeao.emissao_corpo: Karbon emisen hem i taem we gas olsem CO₂ i go aot long elpa, blong moa yet from faea blong fosil fuel, kilim daon bus, wok blong fektri, mo trafik blong evride.
acordeao.clima_titulo: Olsem wanem hem i afektem klaemet?
acordeao.clima_corpo: Gas blong grinhaos i mekem wan les we i holemtaet hit insaed elpa. Moa emisen, moa bigfala efek — mo hemia nao i pulum global wom mo jenis blong klaemet.
acordeao.pegada_corpo: Hem i totol blong gas blong grinhaos we i kamaot, stret o no stret, from wanem wan man, kompani, o prodak i mekem long laef blong hem evride.
acordeao.neutro_corpo: Kabon niutral i traem balansem o pembak emisen we i kamaot. Carbono consciente i putum fas olgeta juis we i stretem efek long envaironment, bifo nomo we man i tingting long pembak.

fatos.fato1: Wan bigfala tri we i mature i save tekem raonabaot 22 kg CO₂ evri yia — dat i mekem se plantim bak trii (reforestesen) hem i wan long ol gudfala wei blong stretem doun emisen.
fatos.fato2: Ol solwota long wol i tekem raonabaot wan kwata (1/4) blong olgeta CO₂ we man i mekem i kamaot evri yia, olsem wan bigfala masin blong kontrolim klaemet blong wol.
fatos.fato3: Taem yu risaikolem wan ton pepa, yu sevim raonabaot 17 trii mo bigfala hamas wota mo paoa, winim taem yu mekem niufala pepa.
fatos.fato4: Transpot i mekem raonabaot wan kwata blong olgeta emisen CO₂ long wol we i joen wetem paoa — jenisim ka wetem baesikol o pablik transpot long sot trip i mekem rili defrens.
fatos.fato5: Amazon i stap haos blong raonabaot 10% blong olgeta kaen laef (baiodaevesiti) we man i save long wol, mo i stoarem bilian-bilian ton blong kabon insaed long ol plant blong hem.
fatos.fato6: Solar panel long haos i save stretem doun kabon futprint blong wan haos wetem sam ton CO₂ evri yia, i dipen long kaen paoa we eria blong yu i yusum.
fatos.fato7: Fudmoa wetem smol red mit nomo i save stretem doun kabon futprint blong wan man tumas, from we kaoa famin i wan long ol fama wok we i mekem bigfala emisen.
fatos.fato8: Ael long Aktik we i melt i mekem se paoa blong wol blong sanwe bak lelaet blong san i go long spes i go doun, mo i mekem se wol i hot kwik — oli kolim disfala samting albedo fidbak.
fatos.fato9: LED laet i yusum 80% les paoa winim ol olfala laet (insandesen) mo i stap longtaem moa, mo i stretem doun emisen mo rabis.
fatos.fato10: Paris Agrimen we klosap 200 kantri i saenem, i gat gol blong holembak hot blong wol aninit long 2°C antap long level bifo indastri i stat.
fatos.fato11: Raonabaot wan haf blong tri (1/3) blong olgeta kakae we wol i mekem i westem — mo disfala wan nomo i mekem bigfala pat blong emisen blong greenhouse gas long wol.
fatos.fato12: Ol niufala win tarbin i save mekem inaf paoa blong givim paoa long taosen-taosen haos, wetaot we i aotem CO₂ taem i wok.
fatos.fato13: Gudfala graon i stoarem moa kabon winim evri plant mo earskae tugeta — ol fama wok we i rijenaretiv i halpem blong holem kabon ya insaed long graon.
fatos.fato14: Ol koral rif, nomata we i kavremap les long 1% blong botom blong solwota, i holemap raonabaot 25% blong olgeta laef long solwota we man i save — mo oli sensitiv tumas long hot blong wota.
fatos.fato15: Stretem doun westem blong hot wota long haos (olsem, sotfala wash) i stretem doun emisen tu, from we hotim wota i yusum paoa.
fatos.fato16: Ol elektrik ka, nomata yu kaontem taem oli mekem battery, oli save aotem les CO₂ long fulap laef blong olgeta winim ol ka we i yusum fuel, speseli sapos elektrisiti i kamaot long klin sos.
fatos.fato17: Taem yu compostem ol rabis we i kamaot long plant mo kakae long haos, i blokem methane blong kamaot long lanfil — wan greenhouse gas we i strong moa winim CO₂ long sot taem.
fatos.fato18: Ol aesblok blong Greenland mo Antarctica tugeta i lusum, long lastfala sam yia, handred-handred bilian ton blong aes evri yia, mo i mekem se wota blong solwota i go antap.
